title: Etch A Sketch toy locked in briefcase for Utah ranch tamper-proof experiment
description: Color photo of an open briefcase with black lining containing a red Etch A Sketch drawing toy with a blank gray screen; a timestamp reads "12/08/2009 14:30." Text above explains the locked briefcases of "brain teaser" games are placed in a "hotspot" on the ranch for a month and then returned to Las Vegas to be examined for differences.
